Global Airline Rankings Announced for 2026

A ranking of the world's top 20 airlines for 2026 has been released, with carriers from Asia and the Middle East securing a significant number of awards. Six European airlines were included in the top 20. Individual categories saw wins for Air France, Turkish Airlines, and Vueling. The rankings are based on passenger numbers.
